name: BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT
description: BEN_PRTT_ENRT_RSLT identifies the plans or option in plans in which a participant is enrolled, either through explicit election or due to system default/automatic enrollments.  It always identifies a plan and the life event reason ,which, in this context may be an open enrollment, that caused the enrollment.  Where applicable , the elected program and option are identified.
